response.sql:
WITH telescope_weather_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    s.telescref,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
), qualifying_groups AS (
  SELECT tw.*
  FROM telescope_weather_avgs AS tw
  CROSS JOIN overall AS ov
  WHERE tw.avg_modindex > ov.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  qg.weathprofile,
  AVG(qg.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
  AVG(qg.avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
  AVG(qg.avg_modindex - ov.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_overall_modindex
FROM qualifying_groups AS qg
CROSS JOIN overall AS ov
GROUP BY qg.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is across all rows in signals, including signals without a matching telescope or observatory; unmatched signals are dropped from the telescope/weather groups as requested.

alternatives.interpretation: If the overall average should use only signals that match a telescope and observatory, calculate it over the joined population instead.
